description: Fix critical issues in minimum price validation: falsy zero check, missing input validation, and currency formatting

steps.name: Write regression tests for minimum price validation
steps.description: Create tests that fail with current code to prove the bugs exist
criteria: Test that warning displays when minPrice = 0 and estimatedValue = -1 (currently fails because 0 is falsy)
Test that admin cannot save negative minPrice values (currently fails, accepts negative)
Test that error toast shows for invalid input (currently no validation)
Test that currency formatting is €X.XX not €X (currently fails, shows €X)
steps.implementation_notes: Tests must reproduce the exact bugs described in RCA. Use React Testing Library for component tests. Mock apiRequest for API calls.
acceptance_criteria: All 4 tests FAIL with current code
Tests are isolated and independently runnable

steps.name: Implement minimum price validation fixes
steps.description: Fix the three critical bugs and make all tests pass
criteria: Fix falsy zero check: change condition from `minPrice &&` to `minPrice !== null`
Add input validation in handleSaveMinPrice: parse and validate number, show error if NaN or negative
Add minPrice error state to admin-fee-tiers component
Display validation error in admin UI when invalid input detected
steps.implementation_notes: Minimal fixes only - no refactoring beyond what's required to fix the bugs. Use existing toast/error patterns from codebase.
acceptance_criteria: All regression tests from 01-01 now PASS
All existing tests still pass (no regressions)
Both critical and medium issues resolved
Error feedback visible to users in both components
